craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 13. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 12. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: The rite all previously told: that is desired to be concise, devoid of guru-and-other worship, in the external for enjoyment, because it.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ sa tu saṃkṣipta iṣyate gurvādipūjārahito bāhye bhogāya sā yataḥ
